subject: MAP: lockstep procurement deadline & target close — clarification
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Rivera <danielle@atlasanalytics.com>; Procurement Team <procurement@atlasanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + post-call recap (target close & procurement runway)

Hi Danielle — thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery call and an initial MAP attached (redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx). Goal here is to make the remaining steps explicit so your procurement team can see the runway to signature.

Key context
- Use case: embed model-powered summarization into Atlas Insights for enterprise customers (PII redaction required).
- Success criteria: <3s median latency at 256 tokens; per-embedding cost target under $0.10; SOC2 evidence in place.

Tentative target close: 2026-04-15
Procurement/signature deadline (to meet target close): 2026-04-09

Draft MAP milestones (high-level)
1) Completion of security questionnaire & evidence (owner: Atlas procurement) — target 2026-03-31
2) Finalize SOW + commercial terms (owner: Atlas legal + Redwood sales) — target 2026-04-05
3) Internal technical POC (2-week window, owner: Atlas engineering with Redwood solutions) — 2026-04-06 to 2026-04-13
4) PO issuance & signature (owner: Atlas procurement/finance) — by 2026-04-09

Dependencies
- Procurement lead confirmation and PO timeline from Atlas (single biggest gating item).
- SOC2 report access or attestation (we can provide SOC2 Type II artifacts via secure share).
- Test data access for the POC (anonymized subset).

Action items from our side
- Neha: update MAP with Ben's cost/latency row and share redlined v2 after your procurement confirms dates (today/tomorrow).
- Ben: provide quantization + batch configuration options for the POC (attached notes).
- Marissa: coordinate a 30-min PO prep call with Atlas procurement if they want a walkthrough of invoicing and SOW.

Danielle — can you confirm: 1) is 2026-04-09 for signature feasible for your procurement team? 2) who is the procurement POC (name + email)? 3) are there any internal calendar blackouts we should know about?

Attachments: redwood-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP draft), procurement-checklist.pdf (explainers, billing cadence)

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + post-call recap (target close & procurement runway)

Neha — quick internal notes and suggested edits to the attached MAP before we send v2 to Atlas: 
- Add a "cost + perf" row under milestones describing expected token throughput, two config options (latency-first vs cost-first), and estimated $/1000 tokens. I sketched numbers in the spreadsheet.
- Move the POC window earlier if Atlas can start test data by 2026-04-04 (so we have 7 full days for regression checks).
- Add a fallback model variant in case quantized variant fails perf targets in the POC.

Also asking: do we have a copy of the SOC2 snapshot we can drop in the Drive link? If not, Marissa, can you surface the secure link to SOC2 artifacts for Danielle?

I'll be available to join the procurement prep call if they want a quick overview of invoicing terms.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft + post-call recap (target close & procurement runway)

Neha — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. I reviewed with our procurement and legal leads this morning. Quick confirmations: 

1) Procurement signature deadline: 2026-04-08 (procurement asked to keep one business day buffer) — so your note of 2026-04-09 is acceptable but we'll aim for 04-08 if possible.
2) We can confirm a target close of 2026-04-15 provided the POC completes and legal signs off by 04-06.
3) Procurement POC: Aaron Miles (aaron.miles@atlasanalytics.com) will be the day-to-day contact; procurement@atlasanalytics.com is our shared inbox for PO issuance.

As for dependencies: we need the SOC2 summary and a one-page data handling checklist for our security review (can you provide both by EOD Monday 29-Mar?). Also, our legal asks for a small redline around data retention — I attached a short note (see comment inline in the MAP Google doc link).

We'll provision anonymized sample data for the POC by 2026-04-04 if Redwood can confirm the test harness and endpoint details by EOD 2026-04-03.

Thanks — Danielle
Danielle Rivera

Danielle — really appreciate the quick review and the procurement POC info. Summary of updates based on your reply and Ben's notes: 

Updated commitments
- Procurement signature target: 2026-04-08 (Atlas preferred). We will plan to have final SOW + commercial terms to you by 2026-04-05 for legal review.
- POC window: 2026-04-04 to 2026-04-10 (we'll aim to compress tests and deliverables so legal can sign on the 6th).
- SOC2 & data handling one-pager: Redwood to deliver secure Drive link by EOD 2026-03-29.

Immediate next steps
- Neha: redact and upload SOC2 summary and data-handling checklist to Drive; share link to Atlas and include in redwood-MAP-v2.
- Ben: finalize the cost/perf options in the MAP and add a fallback model variant row (due 2026-03-30).
- Marissa: schedule a 30-minute procurement walkthrough with Aaron and procurement@atlasanalytics.com for 2026-03-31 or 2026-04-01 (please propose windows).

If anyone at Atlas needs an earlier sync with legal, I can join a 15–20 minute call to walk through billing cadence and indemnity items.

I'll upload redwood-MAP-v2 (redlined) and share the Drive link once the SOC2 artifact is available. Thanks again — looking forward to locking this in.
